Interior plate for a historical docudrama — a cramped one-room startup office in Palo Alto at night, 1995: two cheap desks pushed together, beige tower PCs with deep CRT monitors showing code, tangled cables, stacked pizza boxes and instant-noodle cups, a sleeping bag and pillow rolled under one desk, a whiteboard dense with marker scrawl, venetian blinds closed. Lit by one warm tungsten desk lamp and pale CRT glow, everything else falling into darkness. Period-accurate mid-1990s detail — no flat screens, no modern devices. Vertical 9:16-friendly composition. RAW 35mm Kodak Portra 400 color, real shadow falloff, real material texture, believable physical detail everywhere. NOT a 3D render, NOT smoothed, NOT an AI-CGI look — a real photographed location, muted unpolished documentary grade, photojournalism feel. No people anywhere in frame.
